_comment: Copy this file to content_library.json and fill it with YOUR real resume content. This is the entire source of truth for resume tailoring -- the LLM call in resume_builder.py selects, reorders, and lightly rewords content FROM this file only. It is explicitly instructed never to invent employers, dates, titles, or quantitative claims not present here. employer_bullets are meant to be fixed (never dropped or fabricated, may be reordered within an employer); projects/tagline/profile are the flexible pool it selects and adapts from per job description. This file is gitignored -- your real version never gets committed.
tagline_options: A resume tagline variant, e.g. 'Software Engineer  •  Focus Area  •  Focus Area'
A second variant emphasizing different strengths
A third variant if you want more framing options for the model to choose from
profile_summary_options: A profile-summary paragraph variant matching one framing of your experience.
A second variant emphasizing a different angle (e.g. more AI/agentic-focused).
A third variant if useful (e.g. more generalist full-stack framing).

bullets.text: A real, specific bullet describing what you did and its impact.

projects.name: Project Name
projects.description: What it does, what's technically interesting about it, and any real metrics.
